author: John Hammond
description:
ClickFix attacks have become common, but the payload details are worth paying attention to.

I came across a particularly interesting example that uses a Windows command to search Firefox profiles, identify a file by size, copy it to a temporary directory, and run it as a batch script.

Full video: https://youtu.be/oJHOlNTH7lY?si=JdmZpIm3jVq6Hpvt
title: ClickFix Gets Sneaky
